educationHouseholdShare.citation: Share of a person's education draw their household holds in common: spouses' schooling correlates about 0.5 to 0.6 in the United States (Schwartz and Mare 2005, Demography 42(4):621-646, educational homogamy).

faithHouseholdShare.citation: Share of a person's faith draw their household holds in common: 39% of Americans married since 2010 have a spouse in a different religious group (Pew Research Center, America's Changing Religious Landscape, 2015), so about 0.6 match.
